recentItems.description:

recentItems.title: Trump says he expects Iran talks to resume this week, President Pezeshkian speaks out
recentItems.description:
President Trump says he expects talks with Tehran to resume this week. This comes after Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian spoke to "Face The Nation" moderator Margaret Brennan about a potential peace deal with the U.S. Courtney Kealy has more.
